title: inode 与硬链接/软链接：link count 与删除语义模拟
expected_output:
=== create /data/file.txt (data='hello') ===
after create:
    /data/file.txt inode#1  link_count=1  data='hello'
=== hard link: ln /data/file.txt /data/hard.txt ===
after ln:
    /data/file.txt inode#1  link_count=2  data='hello'
    /data/hard.txt inode#1  link_count=2  data='hello'
    same inode object shared: True
    hard links cannot cross filesystems (inode numbers are per-fs)
=== symbolic link: ln -s /data/file.txt /data/soft.txt ===
after ln -s:
    /data/file.txt inode#1  link_count=2  data='hello'
    /data/hard.txt inode#1  link_count=2  data='hello'
    /data/soft.txt symlink -> /data/file.txt
=== rm /data/file.txt ===
    unlink '/data/file.txt': inode#1 link_count -> 1
    inode#1 link_count > 0 -> data STILL intact
after rm:
    /data/hard.txt inode#1  link_count=1  data='hello'
    /data/soft.txt symlink -> /data/file.txt
    resolve hard.txt : '/data/hard.txt' -> inode#1
    resolve soft.txt : ENOENT: dangling symlink '/data/soft.txt' -> '/data/file.txt'
=== now rm /data/hard.txt (the last hard link) ===
    unlink '/data/hard.txt': inode#1 link_count -> 0
    inode#1 link_count == 0 -> data blocks FREED
after rm hard link:
    /data/soft.txt symlink -> /data/file.txt
    resolve soft.txt : ENOENT: dangling symlink '/data/soft.txt' -> '/data/file.txt'
    -> symlink is now DANGLING: its inode exists, but the path is gone
=== key rule ===
    rm = unlink: decrement link_count of the SAME inode; free only at 0
    symlink has its own inode and stores a PATH STRING, never the data
code:
"""模拟 inode 与硬链接 / 软链接的语义差异（纯模型，确定性输出）。"""

class Inode:
    _next = 1
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.ino = Inode._next
        Inode._next += 1
        self.data = data
        self.link_count = 0          # 硬链接计数（inode 引用计数）
        self.is_symlink = False
        self.target_path = None

class DirEntry:
    """目录项：名字 -> inode。文件名不在 inode 里。"""
    def __init__(self):
        self.names = {}

    def link(self, name, inode):
        if name in self.names:
            raise FileExistsError(name)
        self.names[name] = inode
        inode.link_count += 1

    def unlink(self, name):
        inode = self.names.pop(name, None)
        if inode is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(name)
        if inode.is_symlink:
            print(f"    unlink '{name}': symlink has its own inode -> freed, target count unchanged")
            return
        inode.link_count -= 1
        print(f"    unlink '{name}': inode#{inode.ino} link_count -> {inode.link_count}")
        if inode.link_count == 0:
            print(f"    inode#{inode.ino} link_count == 0 -> data blocks FREED")
        else:
            print(f"    inode#{inode.ino} link_count > 0 -> data STILL intact")

    def resolve(self, name):
        inode = self.names.get(name)
        if inode is None:
            return None, f"ENOENT: '{name}' not found"
        if inode.is_symlink:
            target = inode.target_path
            t = self.names.get(target)
            if t is None:
                return None, f"ENOENT: dangling symlink '{name}' -> '{target}'"
            return t, f"symlink '{name}' -> target '{target}' (inode#{t.ino})"
        return inode, f"'{name}' -> inode#{inode.ino}"

def show(dir_, label):
    print(label)
    for n in sorted(dir_.names):
        i = dir_.names[n]
        if i.is_symlink:
            print(f"    {n:10s} symlink -> {i.target_path}")
        else:
            print(f"    {n:10s} inode#{i.ino}  link_count={i.link_count}  data={i.data!r}")

print("=== create /data/file.txt (data='hello') ===")
d = DirEntry()
hello = Inode("hello")
d.link("/data/file.txt", hello)
show(d, "after create:")

print("=== hard link: ln /data/file.txt /data/hard.txt ===")
d.link("/data/hard.txt", hello)          # 同一个 inode
show(d, "after ln:")
print("    same inode object shared:", d.names["/data/file.txt"] is d.names["/data/hard.txt"])
print("    hard links cannot cross filesystems (inode numbers are per-fs)")

print("=== symbolic link: ln -s /data/file.txt /data/soft.txt ===")
soft = Inode("hello")                    # 软链接是独立 inode
soft.is_symlink = True
soft.target_path = "/data/file.txt"
soft.link_count = 1
d.names["/data/soft.txt"] = soft
show(d, "after ln -s:")

print("=== rm /data/file.txt ===")
d.unlink("/data/file.txt")
show(d, "after rm:")
i, msg = d.resolve("/data/hard.txt")
print("    resolve hard.txt :", msg)
i, msg = d.resolve("/data/soft.txt")
print("    resolve soft.txt :", msg)

print("=== now rm /data/hard.txt (the last hard link) ===")
d.unlink("/data/hard.txt")
show(d, "after rm hard link:")
i, msg = d.resolve("/data/soft.txt")
print("    resolve soft.txt :", msg)
print("    -> symlink is now DANGLING: its inode exists, but the path is gone")
print("=== key rule ===")
print("    rm = unlink: decrement link_count of the SAME inode; free only at 0")
print("    symlink has its own inode and stores a PATH STRING, never the data")
